title: Phase 2: Add Retry Logic with Exponential Backoff
description:
Add retry logic for transient summarization failures.

Requirements:
- 3 retry attempts maximum
- Exponential backoff between retries
- Only retry transient errors: 429 (rate limit), timeout, 5xx
- Do NOT retry: 4xx (except 429), parsing errors, permanent failures

Use errorMessage/retryCount fields already added to QueueItem.
